subject: A sourced rate dataset for "How Much Does It Cost to Hire a Mobile App Developer in Sri Lanka?"
body:
Hi Abbacus Technologies (Editorial team),
I read "How Much Does It Cost to Hire a Mobile App Developer in Sri Lanka?" (https://www.abbacustechnologies.com/?p=36971). One thing that might be useful the next time it is updated: we publish the developer
rate data behind projectcostestimator.com as an open dataset - hourly rates for 12 platforms across 6 markets,
freelancer and agency, with the sources listed, under CC BY 4.0:
https://projectcostestimator.com/rate-database
The calculator itself is free and needs no account, if a worked example helps the piece:
https://projectcostestimator.com/calculator
If you use either, a link back to the page is the only thing I would ask. If a specific number or a custom cut of
the data would help, reply and I will send it.
If this is not useful, reply "no" and I will not write again, or use this link and it stops on its own: https://projectcostestimator.com/api/unsubscribe?e=contact%40abbacustechnologies.com&s=32d4cc97c0009031b3b8992802db22a3
Florin Florea
founder, Project Cost Estimator
hello@projectcostestimator.com
Project Cost Estimator, Aleea Tudor Neculai 90A, Iasi, Romania
